data.raw_text:
MANILA, Philippines — The Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) on Wednesday, announced the deployment of around 1,000 personnel to assist in traffic management, public safety, emergency response, and clearing operations for activities related to the Feast of the Black Nazarene.

Read more: https://t.co/LqezBTYyDA
